title: Review: Balanced equations and reacting masses; The mole and Avogadro constant; Limiting reagent and yield; Empirical and molecular formulae
source: Questions copied unchanged from the mission-lesson scripts for CCEA A-level Chemistry (status of the source: mission-lesson scripts of Oct-Nov 2026 (reviewed by AI reviewers; not signed off by a person)). Terms and clues: AM01#t2 term and clue written for the game; AM01#t3 term and clue written for the game; AM01#t1 term and clue written for the game; AM09#t1 term and clue written for the game. Questions: AM01#N.8a, AM02#N.5, AM07#N.12a, AM09#N.10b, AM01#N.3a, AM02#N.7a, AM07#N.14, AM09#N.4a, AM01#N.9, AM02#N.11, AM07#N.4a, AM09#N.6. Some questions repeat from the worlds it reviews.

assemble.prompt: Match each term to its definition.

items.label: Amount of substance
items.clue: The quantity with symbol n, found by dividing a mass by M.

items.label: Avogadro constant
items.clue: Multiply n by this value to get the number of particles, N.

items.label: Mole
items.clue: The unit of the quantity n; one of these of CO₂ contains three of atoms.

items.label: Limiting reactant
items.clue: The starting substance used up first, which fixes the maximum quantity of product.

questions.stem: How many ions are there in 5.55 g of calcium chloride, CaCl₂? (N_A = 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹; Ar: Cl 35.5, Ca 40.1)
A compound of aluminium and sulfur contains 35.93% aluminium and 64.07% sulfur by mass. What is its empirical formula? Data: Ar Al 27.0, S 32.1.
questions.explanation: Divide each mass by its atomic mass: Al 1.33, S 2.00. Ratio 1 : 1.50; × 2 = 2 : 3.

questions.stem: Iron is produced by reducing iron(III) oxide with carbon monoxide: Fe₂O₃(s) + 3CO(g) → 2Fe(s) + 3CO₂(g). What is the maximum mass of iron that can be produced from 40.0 g of iron(III) oxide? (Ar: O 16.0, Fe 55.8)

Thermite is a mixture of aluminium and iron(III) oxide. 2Al(s) + Fe₂O₃(s) → Al₂O₃(s) + 2Fe(l). A mixture of 10.0 g of Al and 10.0 g of Fe₂O₃ reacts, and 5.60 g of iron is collected. What is the percentage yield of iron? (Molar masses: Al 27.0, Fe₂O₃ 159.6, Fe 55.8 g mol⁻¹)
questions.explanation: n(Al) = 0.370 mol; n(Fe₂O₃) = 0.0627 mol. Divided by coefficients, 0.185 against 0.0627: Fe₂O₃ limits. n(Fe) = 2 × 0.0627 = 0.125 mol; theoretical 6.99 g. 5.60 ÷ 6.99 × 100 = 80.1%.

questions.stem: How many atoms are there in 0.500 mol of water, H₂O? (N_A = 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹)
A hydrocarbon contains 88.80% carbon and 11.20% hydrogen by mass. Its Mr is 54.0. What is its molecular formula? (Ar: H 1.0, C 12.0)
A strip of magnesium burns brightly in air and leaves white magnesium oxide: 2Mg(s) + O₂(g) → 2MgO(s). What mass of MgO forms from 2.43 g of Mg? (Ar: O 16.0, Mg 24.3)
Nitrogen and hydrogen react: N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g). A mixture contains 5.60 g of N₂ and 1.50 g of H₂. Which statement is correct? (Aᵣ: H 1.0, N 14.0)

options.text: H₂ is limiting, because a smaller mass of H₂ is present.
H₂ is limiting, because the equation needs three times as much H₂ as N₂.
H₂ is limiting: 0.750 mol H₂ needs 2.25 mol N₂, and only 0.200 mol N₂ is present.
N₂ is limiting: 0.200 mol N₂ needs 0.600 mol H₂, and 0.750 mol H₂ is present.

questions.explanation: n(N₂) = 5.60 ÷ 28.0 = 0.200 mol; n(H₂) = 1.50 ÷ 2.0 = 0.750 mol. N₂ needs 3 × 0.200 = 0.600 mol H₂, which is available, so N₂ runs out first.

questions.stem: A one-carat diamond is pure carbon with a mass of 0.200 g. About how many carbon atoms does it contain? Data: Ar C 12.0; N_A = 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹.
questions.explanation: n = 0.200 g ÷ the molar mass of C = 0.0167 mol. N = 0.0167 mol × N_A = 1.00 × 10²² atoms.

questions.stem: Ethyne, a welding gas, and benzene, a liquid, both contain 92.3% carbon and 7.7% hydrogen by mass. What is the molecular formula of benzene? Data: Ar H 1.0, C 12.0. Mr of benzene = 78.0.
questions.explanation: C: 92.3 ÷ 12 ≈ 7.7; H: 7.7 ÷ 1 ≈ 7.7. Ratio 1 : 1, empirical formula CH (about 13). x = 78 ÷ 13 = 6: C₆H₆.

questions.stem: Aluminium burns in oxygen to form aluminium oxide. Which equation for this reaction is correctly balanced?
questions.explanation: Al₂O₃ and O₂ are the right formulae. 3O₂ gives 6 O = 2Al₂O₃, which needs 4Al. 4 Al and 6 O each side.

questions.stem: Which statement describes the theoretical yield of a product in a reaction?

options.text: The mass of product actually obtained at the end of the experiment
The total mass of all the reactants put in, since mass is conserved
The mass of product calculated from the amount of the limiting reactant
The mass of product calculated from the reactant with the smaller number of moles

questions.explanation: The theoretical yield is the maximum mass of product, from the limiting reactant and the mole ratio, assuming complete reaction and no losses.
